biography.value:
One of Selyse's geas-held pawns. Three of them ambush the party on the desert road alongside Zephyr; three more wait deep in the hideout, one of whom is Selyse in disguise.

They fight without heart and without choice. Once Selyse and Amira are defeated, any survivors are free from control and offer the party treasure from the stolen hoard.

Stat block (SRD Bandit)

AC 12 (leather armour). HP 11 (2d8+2). Speed 30 ft. Languages any one language (usually Common).

Scimitar. +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) slashing damage.

Light Crossbow. +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage.
